segments.contextAfter: The [`normal`](scnmaterial/normal.md) property specifies the orientation of a surface at each point. Materials are uniformly smooth by default, so specifying a color for this property has no useful effect. Instead, you can specify an image for this property that describes the contours of the surface. SceneKit uses this image (called a normal map) in lighting, creating the illusion of a complex, bumpy surface without increasing the complexity of the geometry.
